description: 16 Hours Audio Playback Time Keep the music going from day to night. With up to 16 hours of uninterrupted playback, the Reconnect Jive Duet is built for extended karaoke sessions without frequent charging. Whether it's an all-day celebration, a family get-together or a late-night singalong, enjoy uninterrupted entertainment with a battery that keeps up with every performance. Change the Voice. Change the Vibe Every performance deserves a new personality. Switch between five exciting voice effects including Male to Female, Female to Male, Baby Voice, Magic Sound and KTV Mode to make every song more entertaining. Whether you're singing solo or challenging friends, Jive Duet transforms every karaoke session into an unforgettable experience. Built-in Mic Holder Everything you need, always within reach. The thoughtfully designed built-in microphone holder keeps your wireless karaoke mics secure and organised, so you're always ready to sing. With dual wireless microphones included, enjoy hassle-free duets without tangled wires or misplaced accessories.
